其余状态码（400 / 401 / 403 / 404 / 413 / 422: Other status codes (400 / 401 / 403 / 404 / 413 / 422, etc.) are definitive rejections; retrying will also fail, so they are bubbled up immediately.
原样重发同一个请求。流一旦开始（已经拿到 200），中途断开就不归这层管了。: Retransmit the same request as is. Once the stream starts (200 received), mid-stream disconnections are not handled by this layer.
HTTP 200、finish_reason 是正常 stop，但整条响应一个内: HTTP 200, finish_reason is normal stop, but no content blocks in response—caused by gateway empty frames, dropped thinking fields, or sampling hiccups.
因 max_tokens 截断而没有内容的不算（那要靠调高输出上限解决，重发只会: Does not include truncations due to max_tokens (this requires increasing the output limit; retransmitting will just hit it again).
重发整个 prompt，所以在长上下文上比较贵，次数不宜给大。: Resends the entire prompt, which is costly for long contexts, so set the count carefully.
同 provider 安全窗口重试: Retry within same provider safety window

在同一个配置上重放同一个请求。因为还没交付任何输出，重放不会重复模型输出或工具执: Replay the same request on the same configuration. Since no output has been delivered, replaying will not duplicate model output or tool execution.

成功一次即清零，所以偶尔抽风的配置不会被慢慢攒到熔断。: Resets to zero after one success, so occasionally flaky configurations don't slowly build up to a circuit break.
熔断后进入冷却，冷却期内轮询直接跳过这个配置。状态落库，重启不丢。: Enters cooldown after circuit break; polling skips this configuration during cooldown. State is stored in DB and persists across restarts.

额度耗尽已经由轮询换配置处理，不在这里重跑；任务被暂停 / 终止 / 进入收尾时: Quota exhausted is handled by polling rotation, not re-run here; tasks paused/terminated/finished immediately yield, consuming no backoff time.
整条意图从头再跑一遍。它是最外层，一次重跑意味着里面几层的次数会再乘一遍。: Run the entire intent again from scratch. It is the outermost layer; one re-run multiplies the counts of inner layers.

数字越大越先被选中；激活配置恒为第 1 顺位，与本值无关。相同优先级的配置会轮流: Higher number means higher priority; active config is always rank 1, regardless of this value. Configs with same priority rotate, naturally load balancing.
